widgets_values: This method is used more as a simple crop that allows you to generate details, erase specific areas of an image, etc. How you use it will depend on what you want to add in the preprocessing group. As you can see, what the node exports in this case is simply the already cropped image and mask outputs

widgets_values:
This method, on the other hand, is more intended for pure inpainting, without having to add nodes in between. It is designed to connect the latent and the model directly. This method allows you to access progressive inpainting parameters that are essential with models that, naturally, do not do inpainting.

So take it more as a local and controlled IMG2IMG.
